messages:
joel: heads-up: fallback auth is spiking again when hosted routes forward to Dedicated/Private. different runtimes reject tokens for different reasons (aud, alg, issuer). we need a standard handshake pattern not ad-hoc fixes.

sunita: saw 3 failure classes: aud mismatch, alg (rs256 vs es256), and tenant id namespace. each fix so far is special-case. messy and risky.

marc: proposal A: canonical bridge JWT minted by control-plane with fields {iss: redwood-bridge, aud: runtime-id, sub: tenant, exp: short}. runtime verifies iss + signature using our published bridge public key. advantage: simple verify path in runtime.

olga: Proposal B: runtime validates original hosted token via introspection call to control-plane and the control-plane returns a signed attestation for runtime consumption. pros: runtime sees original context. cons: extra roundtrip on fallback.

joel: tradeoffs: A is lowest-latency (one extra token attach). B preserves original claims for auditing. we can combine: issue bridge token plus include opaque reference to original token id. runtime can call introspect only when it needs more context.

sunita: security note: bridge JWT must never convey decryption or key access scopes. only allowed scope: invoke-inference. add aud and scope checks in runtime.

marc: rotation: bridge signing key must be on a monthly rotation schedule with overlap. runtime should accept previous key for grace window. document JWK endpoint for runtimes to fetch keys.

olga: telemetry: add metrics: fallback_count, bridge_token_issuance_latency, bridge_cache_hit, fallback_auth_failures_by_reason. these are critical for SLA monitoring.

infra-bot: canary: credential-bridge v0.2 deployed to staging (5 pods) 1766021160

joel: perf: target cold bridge issuance <20ms, cached path <5ms. sunita: we should microbenchmark PoP vs bearer flow. PoP adds CPU on runtime for sig verify.

sunita: opt-out: tenant manifest flag "bridge_handshake": "enabled|disabled" default disabled for Private. for Disabled, fallbacks must fail-fast and surface clear error to caller.

marc: audit: every bridge token issuance must emit an immutable audit event with request id, issuing node id, tenant, target runtime, and decision (granted|denied). store in append-only log; expose to customers for Private if requested.

olga: air-gap: for air-gapped customers, provide an operator-managed bundle: signed bridge key + manifest config they install locally. then control-plane never transmits keys. document operator flow.

joel: actionables: 1) Marc draft handshake RFC with token shape + rotation + telemetry, 2) Sunita run PoP vs bearer perf microbenchmarks, 3) Olga draft audit & air-gap operator bundle doc, 4) I'll add tenant manifest flag + console UI change.

marc: will have RFC by EOD tomorrow. ping @joel for review.

infra-bot: note: slack-alert-rule lowered noise threshold for fallback-auth channel for next 48h.
